points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata, toModel })` is in `blocksuite/framework/store/src/model/block/zod.ts`. The flavour is a namespaced string such as `'affine:paragraph'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (for example `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
`props: (internal) => ({...})` gives the default props. It uses helpers such as `internal.Text()`.
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (for example `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>` (`store/src/model/block/block-model.ts`).

The view is a Lit custom element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal\`affine-paragraph\`)` is in `std/src/extension/block-view.ts`. It binds the flavour to that tag.

`StoreExtensionProvider` is in `store.ts`. In `setup(context)` it calls `context.register(...)` with the schema extension and the adapter extensions ... `ViewExtensionProvider` is `ParagraphViewExtension` in `view.ts`. ... An editor or workspace then adds these providers to its store and view extension lists.
It has a `name`, an optional zod `schema` for its options, and an `effect()` that calls `effects()`. That call defines the custom elements.
